meta.title: A reservation is the `Defer()` call; the join starts after the handler ends
meta.subtitle: The call only registers; the join starts when the handler completes normally

messages.label: during handler: JoinSpot(...).Defer() — register only; nothing starts
handler throws → discard registration; do not start join
when accepted, commit location record and membership together
later messages for the Actor run in the User Spot

cards.title: Registration and join happen at different times
items: `Defer()` does not run the join now; it registers the join to start after the handler completes normally.
If the handler throws, its registration is discarded.
